title: Presence
description: What runs where: one reported image digest, and every workload that runs it.

digestKind.description: RepoDigest is a digest that a registry can serve. ImageID is one that no registry can.

repositories.description: The repositories that the digest was pulled from.

workloads.description: Every workload that runs the digest.

apiGroup.description: Empty for the core group, such as for a bare Pod.

pods.description: The pods of the workload that run the digest.

labels.description: The workload's labels that the owner attribution allows, and no others: those of its own object for a Deployment, a StatefulSet, a DaemonSet or a CronJob, and those of its pods for any other workload, such as a bare pod or one of a custom controller.

namespaceLabels.description: The namespace's labels that the owner attribution allows, and no others.

namespaceAnnotations.description: The namespace's annotations that the owner attribution allows, and no others.

node.description: The node that the pod runs on.

platform.description: The platform of the node, as os/arch or os/arch/variant.
